notes.title: Major Multilingual Update
notes.content: Some players reflected that the localization of Japanese Korean was not done well enough, so we re-invited more experienced translation teachers to optimize it, and added eight new languages, Russian, Polish, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), Arabic, French, Italian, German, hoping to reach more players around the globe, and if you have any questions and comments and suggestions, please feel free to contact us ( shanyuhai@shanhaixingchen.com).

notes.title: The adaptation of Mac version is completed, new Bonus Video is added.
notes.content:
We have made the following updates to the game:

notes.title: HD DLC is now available for you to enjoy a better audio and visual experience
notes.content:
DLC content is consistent with the ontology.

HD DLC configuration: 2K, 10bit, 60fps HD video expansion, win10 system needs to install HEVC expansion, 90GB memory, (The game itself is 2K, 8bit, 30fps)

Please click the DLC button in the lower right corner of the game’s main interface to perform the video test first.After downloading the HD DLC, the content of the game will be automatically overwritten. Please ensure that the test is successful before downloading, so as not to affect normal game play. 

Higher quality video can bring you a better game experience. You can download DLC according to your own situation. We hope HD DLC will bring you a better experience.

notes.title: Second update of the official version
notes.content:
The second update of the official version, updated as follows:
1、Fixed the problem that the branch in chapter 7 cannot be solved.
2. Optimized the correct display of achievement names.
3. Fixed the problem that achievements were triggered incorrectly if the conditions were not met.
4. Fixed incorrect display of story line titles.

10、Fix the problem that the speed of the main control bar does not match the display.
11、Separate music volume and video volume in setting interface.
12、Other small problems

notes.title: Breaking News!!! "Superscout" is officially released.
notes.content:
Dear family, with a mix feeling of nervous (this work is going to be submitted) and relief (the work is finally submitted), we are here to announce that the official version of "Superscout" is finally meeting everyone.

First, we would like to thank the players and KOLs from various countries for your attention and support over this period. We have deeply felt your enthusiasm, and your recognition is our driving force.

Secondly, due to development progress issues, the Mac version will be delayed and is expected to be officially released in 1-2 weeks. The HD graphic DLC is still under review, and once approved, it will be released immediately. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused!

This is the second live-action interactive movie game project from our Mountain & Sea Studio (the previous work was "Underworld Island"). We believe we have improved, but there are still many shortcomings. We welcome any feedback and suggestions, and we will carry these forward to make better progress.

Our contact email is: shanyuhai@shanhaixingchen.com

notes.title: Demo 2.0 Second Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone:

Thank you for recognizing the demo of Superscout, according to the feedback from players in different countries, we have updated the demo for the second time, the updates are as follows:

1、UI adaptation for demo's multi-language version has been realized.
2、Fixed the problem that the loading interface would appear when the interface is switched.
3. Optimized the interaction of WeChat interface, players can choose to continue the game when there is no necessary content.
4. Fixed the wrong text in the story line.
5. Added multi-language text in the WeChat function, now players from English, Japanese and Korean can also understand the chat content between characters.

The game continues to be optimized, any problems are welcome to find us feedback, and also welcome to negotiate all kinds of cooperation, contact email: shanyuhai@shanhaixingchen.com.

Mountain&Sea Studio

notes.title: will join the Next Fest in June 10th(PT), please enjoy the DEMO.
notes.content:
Next Fest is an opportunity created by Steam for games from all over the world to connect with the gamers. <Superscout> is proud to be part of this event. We will update the demo at the same time.

Demo2.0 will add one chapter of content to the original version (the game itself has nine chapters, with a single playthrough lasting 5-7 hours) and fix some of the bugs reported by players in version 1.0. 

Currently, there are still some issues with multi-language adaptation, and we will do our best to optimize and resolve them next.

If you encounter any problems while playing, feel free to share them with us. Any form of cooperation is also welcome. 

Our contact email is: shanyuhai@shanhaixingchen.com

We will optimize the feedback in the official version.

Finally, please help us promote the game if you like the demo. Thank you so much! ;D

notes.title: The team focused on making move games came with a new work.
notes.content:
Greetings, everyone. We are Mountain & Sea Studio, dedicated to crafting live-action interactive movie games. At the end of 2022, after “Underworld Island” went online, we began developing this new work. And now, it’s finally coming your way~

The new game you will  be the protagonist, living a fantastic life. The love that lasts lifetimes, urges you to never let it go; the kindness met in this life, is engraved in your soul. Your choices will determine the fate of your loved ones; and your world-line is being changed by those who love you...

We'd like to introduce you to the girls who are going to have a story with “you”, the super scout, and this time, we've tried to create a judgment for the girls, so we hope you'll like it~
